authenticity_review: The image exhibits moderate-to-severe AI generation artifacts that significantly undermine authenticity. Key structural defects include: (1) fused/melted front legs on the second horse from left — limbs merge unnaturally near knees/pasterns; (2) warped head-neck junction on third horse creating subtle 'floating head' effect; (3) toy car wheels lack tread/axle detail, appearing as smooth plastic blobs. Additionally, taxonomy violation is critical: three of four horses display black points (dark manes, tails, lower legs) contradicting the strict 'sorrel' definition requiring uniform brownish-orange coat with no black points. Only the rightmost horse approximates sorrel/flaxen traits. These combined anatomical, textural, and taxonomic failures indicate synthetic origin with notable quality control issues.
